easyPrerequisites: Gift of Immortality attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Brotherhood Outcast trigger, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.
